title: outbuf deferred until first write: correct per-session allocation discipline
description: src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c — outbuf is NULL at open() and at OPERATION fd init. First allocation happens in outbuf_grow() called from write() or finalize(), starting at CRYPTO2DEV_OUTBUF_INIT (4096 bytes) and doubling up to 1MB. Sessions doing only hash never allocate more than 4096 bytes. Sessions opened but never initialized allocate nothing. Pre-allocating 1MB at open() would use 1 GB for 1000 concurrent sessions. A reviewer might suggest pre-allocating for predictability; that makes crypto2dev unusable in services holding many sessions.
